section: Agentic AI in meetings, room scheduling, wayfinding and space management: AVI-SPL Concept Catalog outlook
body:
This article from AVI-SPL's Concept Catalog is a forward look at how Agentic AI is expected to change meetings and the workplace. It is useful when planning rooms and workplace systems, as long as it is presented as an outlook: most of it is phrased as what AI will or can do.

**The argument**
- AI first helped everyone in hybrid meetings feel seen and heard, and virtual assistants then improved the user experience.
- The article says AI is now poised to change work again: support with daily tasks that is personal to each user, more advanced corporate communication, and a different definition of meeting engagement.
- Derrick Kelly, AVI-SPL vice president of solutions enablement, expects the UCC-AI landscape to expand to support any individual work style and environment, with AI moving away from reactive summaries of meetings and becoming a host that prompts people and supports them through the day.
- These capabilities are expected soon to follow individuals across meetings, corporate communications, digital signage, workstation reservations and more.

**Where the article sees the most impact**
- Video meeting analysis: Agentic AI will assess action items, assign tasks and find openings in team schedules for future meetings. It can also help send invites and book rooms. Kelly's example: with a calendar synced to an Agentic AI-enabled platform that transcribes meetings, the system works out who the user said they need to meet and which document they need, and has already started the document or found a working copy.
- Meeting scheduling and wayfinding: users state the type of meeting and number of people instead of scrolling a room list, and the platform returns available spaces and times. After booking, an Agentic AI-enabled wayfinding platform gives personalized directions, which can appear on a personal device and on lobby or hallway displays as the person moves through the office.
- Space management and support: AI is already affecting space management and room devices. A personal AI agent can also help manage a space's power consumption and assess which devices each meeting needs. Smaller or hybrid meetings may need only a touch display on a mobile cart, while larger spaces with larger audiences may need a more traditional setup.
- Customer support: memory and reasoning improve virtual agents through contextual conversations and task-based actions. The virtual agent can resolve challenges, raising satisfaction and freeing support agents for more complex issues.

**Vendor example**
Zoom has built Agentic AI into its AI Companion across Zoom Meetings, Phone, Team Chat, Docs, Contact Center and Virtual Agent. It uses reasoning, memory, action and task details for calendar management, writing assistance and rapid clip creation, adjustable to a user's or IT's needs.

**When to use this**
Use it when a customer asks how AI may affect room booking, wayfinding, room equipment choices or support, and wants AVI-SPL's view of the direction.

**Not stated in this source**: availability dates, licence requirements, or any AVI-SPL deployment of these capabilities.
